caption: The drawing is divided into two main sections: a left panel dominated by decorative floral designs and a right panel containing ornate text. In the left section, swirling blue ribbons accented with red dots and curls intermingle with yellow, orange, and red flowers and green leaves. There is a small brown bird with spread wings beneath the ribbons, and the lower part of the section features a row of light brown buildings, including a church with a cross on its steeple. The right section is bordered with stylized red, yellow, and green flowers and leaves. At the top of this section, there are two blue-winged angels with trumpets, flanking a circular cartouche that contains calligraphic writing. Below the angels, the largest text is written in blue and yellow Gothic script, while just underneath is a line of large, ornate red script. The lower half of this section is filled with brown cursive handwriting. The letters at the very bottom are large, red, and decorative. The background of the drawing is cream-colored, and the entire piece is bordered by a thin, double-lined frame with floral motifs. The overall color palette consists of blue, red, yellow, green, orange, brown, and cream.
title: Fraktur
